python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys

out = Path('.fabro/tmp/selection-partial-quality/result')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
expected = '282e9b8f1f9feba023d73f2c7c04b7270eb3af12'
(out / 'owner.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source': expected, 'purpose': 'source-quality-observation'}) + '\n')

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])

def verify(label):
    head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
    tree = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip()
    assert head == expected, ('wrong HEAD', head, expected)
    assert not git('diff', '--binary') and not git('diff', '--cached', '--binary'), 'tracked diff changed'
    entries = []
    for row in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', '--full-tree', head).split(b'\0'):
        if row:
            meta, path = row.split(b'\t', 1)
            mode, kind, blob = meta.split()
            assert kind == b'blob', ('unsupported tracked entry', path)
            entries.append((mode.decode(), blob, os.fsdecode(path)))
    raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], input=b'\n'.join(blob for _, blob, _ in entries) + b'\n')
    stream = io.BytesIO(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for mode, blob, name in entries:
        header = stream.readline().split()
        assert len(header) == 3 and header[0] == blob and header[1] == b'blob', header
        body = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        assert stream.read(1) == b'\n'
        path = Path(name)
        assert path.is_symlink() or stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode), ('unexpected file kind', name)
        actual_mode = '120000' if path.is_symlink() else '100755' if path.stat().st_mode & 0o111 else '100644'
        actual = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path)) if path.is_symlink() else path.read_bytes()
        assert actual == body and actual_mode == mode, ('tracked bytes/mode differ', name)
        digest.update(os.fsencode(name) + b'\0' + mode.encode() + b'\0' + body)
    assert stream.read() == b''
    result = {'head': head, 'tree': tree, 'index_tree': git('write-tree').decode().strip(), 'files': len(entries), 'actual_bytes_modes_sha256': digest.hexdigest(), 'status': git('status', '--porcelain').decode()}
    assert result['index_tree'] == tree
    (out / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('SOURCE_VERIFIED ' + json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    return result

before = verify('before')
result = subprocess.run(['bin/dev', 'check'])
(out / 'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command': ['bin/dev', 'check'], 'exit': result.returncode, 'source': expected}) + '\n')
print('DEV_CHECK_EXIT ' + str(result.returncode), flush=True)
after = verify('after')
assert before == after, 'source metadata changed during check'
sys.exit(result.returncode)

PY

import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys

out = Path('.fabro/tmp/selection-partial-quality/result')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
expected = '282e9b8f1f9feba023d73f2c7c04b7270eb3af12'
(out / 'owner.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source': expected, 'purpose': 'source-quality-observation'}) + '\n')

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])

def verify(label):
    head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
    tree = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip()
    assert head == expected, ('wrong HEAD', head, expected)
    assert not git('diff', '--binary') and not git('diff', '--cached', '--binary'), 'tracked diff changed'
    entries = []
    for row in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', '--full-tree', head).split(b'\0'):
        if row:
            meta, path = row.split(b'\t', 1)
            mode, kind, blob = meta.split()
            assert kind == b'blob', ('unsupported tracked entry', path)
            entries.append((mode.decode(), blob, os.fsdecode(path)))
    raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], input=b'\n'.join(blob for _, blob, _ in entries) + b'\n')
    stream = io.BytesIO(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for mode, blob, name in entries:
        header = stream.readline().split()
        assert len(header) == 3 and header[0] == blob and header[1] == b'blob', header
        body = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        assert stream.read(1) == b'\n'
        path = Path(name)
        assert path.is_symlink() or stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode), ('unexpected file kind', name)
        actual_mode = '120000' if path.is_symlink() else '100755' if path.stat().st_mode & 0o111 else '100644'
        actual = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path)) if path.is_symlink() else path.read_bytes()
        assert actual == body and actual_mode == mode, ('tracked bytes/mode differ', name)
        digest.update(os.fsencode(name) + b'\0' + mode.encode() + b'\0' + body)
    assert stream.read() == b''
    result = {'head': head, 'tree': tree, 'index_tree': git('write-tree').decode().strip(), 'files': len(entries), 'actual_bytes_modes_sha256': digest.hexdigest(), 'status': git('status', '--porcelain').decode()}
    assert result['index_tree'] == tree
    (out / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('SOURCE_VERIFIED ' + json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    return result

before = verify('before')
result = subprocess.run(['bin/dev', 'check'])
(out / 'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command': ['bin/dev', 'check'], 'exit': result.returncode, 'source': expected}) + '\n')
print('DEV_CHECK_EXIT ' + str(result.returncode), flush=True)
after = verify('after')
assert before == after, 'source metadata changed during check'
sys.exit(result.returncode)
